profile.headline: Backend Engineer | Distributed Systems | AI Infrastructure
profile.summary: Software engineer building cloud infrastructure, AI/ML systems, and backend services at Viridia Solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead backend and AI platform development for a production EV fleet
management platform, building distributed services on AWS for high-volume
telemetry processing and customer-facing analytics.
• Architected an internal AI analytics platform that turns natural-language
fleet questions into database queries, charts, and reports. Defined the
system architecture and integration contracts across backend, agent runtime,
and frontend components.
• Designed and built a cross-product internal AI testing platform that separates from deterministic deployment validation and exploratory testing across product integrations.
• Designed and implemented reliable asynchronous job execution and real-time
result delivery using durable state management, message-driven processing,
resumable streaming, and ownership-based access controls.
• Built and productionized fleet-specific machine-learning models that adjust
for measured route, vehicle, weather, and operating conditions, powering
driver-efficiency rankings and what-if analysis for fleet coaching.
• Deployed and operated private GPU-backed LLM inference using vLLM,
llama.cpp, AWS EC2, and NGINX, substantially reducing serving costs while
supporting internal engineering workflows.
• Mentor junior engineers and support interns through architecture reviews,
pair programming, technical onboarding, implementation planning, and
production debugging.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and deployed distributed NestJS microservices on AWS ECS processing high-volume MQTT telemetry from IoT devices across AWS IoT Core, SNS, SQS, and Redis.

• Built event-driven architectures using SNS, SQS, Kafka, and Redis Pub/Sub for real-time telemetry processing and sub-second event propagation.

• Optimized high-traffic database queries through indexing and query tuning, reducing average execution time by 40%.

• Built trip and route detection systems using spatial and sequential pattern analysis over streaming telemetry data.

• Established CI/CD pipelines and supported production deployments across cloud backend services.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Research in cybersecurity-focused within PLC environment. I assessed the potential security vulnerabilities in the current PLC environment and demonstrated them by conducting cyber attacks and capturing frames.


• Developed a secure client-server environment by building IoT network encryption methods with Zookeeper, Kafka, Zymkey, and MQTT
• Built an elevator system algorithm to evaluate security vulnerabilities in a PLC environment using OpenPLC
• Investigated SCADA protocol vulnerabilities in power grids by conducting MAC flooding attack and capturing flooded frames
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · User Management · Documentation · Test Cases · openPLC · Reliability · Mqtt · Teamwork · Apache Kafka · Python (Programming Language) · Communication · Apache ZooKeeper · Distributed Computing · Critical Thinking · Analytical Skills · Coding Standards · Linux · Zymkey · Debugging · Resolving Issues

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Software development and testing in the robotics environment. In this job, I focused on developing  applications integrated with robots, including mobile applications and embedded applications. I also worked on creating backend structures for safety status, a real-time audio bluetooth remote, and APIs in C.

• Designed and implemented mobile applications to place and manage orders, track order status, and process payments integrated with robots using Android Studio, Flutter, Clover SDK, and QT
• Developed C++ back-end for monitoring the safety status of boba robots
• Designed and built client-server applications and backend for real-time audio bluetooth remote and docent robot integration with ESP32-Lyrat and QT Creator
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · Flutter · User Management · Android Studio · Documentation · Test Cases · Java · Reliability · Teamwork · Dart · Qt Creator · GitHub · Communication · Critical Thinking · Analytical Skills · Coding Standards · Linux · C++ · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Debugging · Business Requirements · Resolving Issues

positions.title: Assistant Web Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for developing a video-on-demand platform for virtual conferences supporting lead web developer. I added features such as an activity logger, activity analyzer, and account management.


• Developed video on-demand-platform for IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems 2020 using Django and MySQL
• Constructed an activity logger and analyzer features to generate demographic visualizations and user statistics
• Developed and deployed features for account creation and account activation
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · User Management · Django · Reliability · Teamwork · GitHub · Python (Programming Language) · JavaScript · Communication · Critical Thinking · Analytical Skills · Coding Standards · Debugging · Resolving Issues

company.name: IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Responsible for employing Microsoft LUIS to train a language understanding service for robotics assistance at hotels in Las Vegas. I also focused on collecting and inserting the hotel's data into the database.


• Trained language understanding service using Microsoft LUIS for assistant robots at hotels
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · User Management · Teamwork · SQL · Microsoft LUIS · Communication · Critical Thinking · Coding Standards · JetBrains DataGrip · Resolving Issues
